title: Homogeneous free bases of graded right DG modules
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be an associative unital differential graded $\mathbf Z$-algebra and $P$ a right DG $A$-module, with homogeneous right action as in [def-sfb-dg-derived-category]. A homogeneous graded right $A$-basis of $P$ consists of a set $J$ in the component-module universe, integers $t_j$, elements $x_j\in P^{t_j}$, and additive equivalences $c_n:P^n\cong\bigoplus_{j\in J}A^{n-t_j}$ for every integer $n$, such that $c_n(x_ja)$ is the vector with coordinate $a$ at $j$ and zero elsewhere for every $a\in A^{n-t_j}$. Here $x_ja$ is transported along $t_j+(n-t_j)=n$. Equivalently, every homogeneous element has a unique finite expansion $\sum_jx_ja_j$ with $a_j\in A^{n-t_j}$. No constraint on the differentials of the generators is part of this definition; no countability is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0CRM, lemma-countable, proof (2) to (1): homogeneous generators chosen from the graded splittings of property (P); Tag 09KP, lemma-resolve.
